_comment: Identity of the public SCPUI mod on Nebula. Packages and their dependencies come from the repo's mod.json; these fields replace the development mod's. tile and banner are sha256 checksums of images already on Nebula.
title: SCPUI
description:
SCPUI is a fully customizable user-interface replacement for the FreespaceOpen Engine. Information on how to customize SCPUI is available on the hard-light Wiki.

[url]https://wiki.hard-light.net/index.php/Scpui[/url]

Source code is available here:
[url]https://github.com/MjnMixael/SCPUI[/url]
